label: Metabarons
game_synopsis: Use the staged lorepack files as the source material for a playable Sans-Nom story. Read the source records before drafting and ground premise, scene setup, choices, and source boundaries in those records.
protagonist_role: Choose or create a playable role from source-supported material in the staged lorepack without replacing established source facts with an unrelated premise.
opening_situation: Start from a concrete situation supported by staged lorepack material.
initial_pressure: Begin with an immediate scene problem grounded in staged lorepack material.
story_lines: Read the staged lorepack source files before drafting.
Build scenes from concrete source-supported characters, places, relationships, objects, events, and conflicts.
Let consequences follow from source material and rolled-out play.
Keep choices playable and consequential without replaying the same situation.
must_not_violate: Do not make major facts contradict staged source material.
Do not turn source-specific material into unrelated generic genre scenes.
Do not resolve major situations without consequences established in play.
Do not flatten characters or groups into exposition devices.
Do not offer choices that only navigate locations without changing situation, knowledge, relationships, resources, or risk.

source_events: Use staged source volumes 1-8 as the source basis for this pack.
Use staged character, page, and volume records for source-supported events.
must_include_canon_facts: The playable story must preserve source-supported facts from the staged lorepack.
allowed_original_insertions: New local figures, places, objects, and scene complications may be created when they do not replace or contradict staged source material.
Original scene details may be introduced if they are consistent with the source and do not become replacement canon.
